body:
Preloaded selected planning widgets, warmed the editor after initial data, and reduced agenda pages to 200 items with explicit Next/First controls. The month grid retains 1,000 items. In the 1,000-card release fixture, constrained warm Calendar falls from 1.73 s to 0.63 s and immediate card opening from 317 to 192 ms. These are synthetic small-sample medians, not physical-device or p95 acceptance.

The full gate, affected Chromium/WebKit suites and calendar gesture tests pass. The existing manual app was rebuilt/restarted and HTTPS verified; all 24 existing resource versions, two pins, preferences and the certificate were preserved.

The performance goal remains active. Focus still waits for separate pinned-card detail reads; that measured bottleneck is next. Evidence: progress/2026-09-29-performance-optimization.md.

metadata.summary: Faster planning views and first-card opening verified
